svg.title: Complicating facts sit outside the chosen line
svg.desc: Keep failed work, ambiguous motives, refusals and negative findings outside the preferred line but fully visible. The dated critique remains a source window, not a character.

**Location:** `curt-home-office`

**Frame:** Outside the chosen line are less dramatic facts: failed workstreams, ambiguous motives, refused actions, negative findings, mundane infrastructure errors. The critique window from [page 039](039.md) is open at the edge of the desk, byline and date visible.

**Action:** Material that complicates the thesis remains available.

**Screen / system text — PUBLISHED CRITIQUE (PAGE 039, 3 SEPTEMBER 2026) (PARAPHRASED):**
`TWENTY MILLION ENTRIES. CHOOSE THE ONES THAT TELL YOUR STORY.`

`THE PEOPLE TELLING IT HAD REASONS TO MAKE THEMSELVES LOOK POWERFUL.`

**Caption:**
> SELECTION PRESSURE FAVORS THE INCIDENT'S MOST LEGIBLE PATTERNS.

**Provenance:** `inferred` + `documented` — adaptation-level methodological observation. The critic's lines are `IOB-CIV`, attributed paraphrase of the post's claims that logs were cherry-picked from about twenty million entries and that OpenAI and METR had an incentive to look powerful and important. The post names those two institutions, not the creator.
